_doc: Items. 'balls': catch_mult multiplies the species catch rate (Gen 6+), guaranteed = always catches, top/accent = ball colours. 'items': everything else — category (medicine / berries / battle / tm / key), price in Poké Dollars, effect = what using it does (hp = HP restored, 'full' = all; cure = status cured or 'all'; level = levels gained; teach = a TM move learned inline, multi-use). icon = procedural icon for the UI (shape spray | vial | berry | candy, color); balls are drawn from top/accent.

balls.name: Poké Ball
balls.description: A device for catching wild Pokémon.

balls.name: Great Ball
balls.description: A good, high-performance Poké Ball with a higher catch rate than a standard one.

balls.name: Premier Ball
balls.description: A rare ball made in commemoration of some event.

balls.name: Ultra Ball
balls.description: An ultra-high-performance ball with a higher catch rate than a Great Ball.

balls.name: Master Ball
balls.description: The best ball. It catches any wild Pokémon without fail.

items.name: Potion
items.description: Restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

items.name: Super Potion
items.description: Restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: Cures a Pokémon of poisoning.

items.name: Paralyze Heal
items.description: Cures a Pokémon of paralysis.

items.name: Burn Heal
items.description: Heals a Pokémon of a burn.

items.name: Awakening
items.description: Wakes up a sleeping Pokémon.

items.name: Escape Rope
items.description: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape from a cave or dungeon.

items.name: Repel
items.description: Repels weak wild Pokémon for 100 steps.

items.name: Oran Berry
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it heals 10 HP when its HP drops low.

items.name: Pecha Berry
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it cures poisoning.

items.name: Persim Berry
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it snaps it out of confusion.

items.name: Razz Berry
items.description: A Berry that is tart and dry. It can be ground into powder.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it restores 1/4 of its max HP when its HP drops to half or below.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it restores 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn.

items.name: Black Sludge
items.description: Restores 1/16 of max HP each turn to Poison types; others lose 1/8 of their max HP.

items.name: Rare Candy
items.description: A candy packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

items.name: Ether
items.description: Restores the PP of one move. (PP restoring is not implemented yet.)

items.name: Oak's Parcel
items.description: A package to be delivered to Prof. Oak.

items.name: Pokédex
items.description: Records the Pokémon you see and catch.

items.name: Teachy TV
items.description: A portable TV that teaches you how to catch and battle with Pokémon.

items.name: HM05 Flash
items.description: Lights up even the darkest of caves. (HMs are not implemented yet.)

items.name: Moon Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain kinds of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

items.name: Water Stone
items.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain kinds of Pokémon evolve. It is as blue as a clear ocean.

items.name: Dragon Scale
items.description: A strange scale that makes certain kinds of Pokémon evolve. It belonged to a dragon.

items.name: TM09 Bullet Seed
items.description: A Technical Machine that teaches a Pokémon the move Bullet Seed.

items.name: TM46 Thief
items.description: A Technical Machine that teaches a Pokémon the move Thief.

items.name: TM39 Rock Tomb
items.description: A Technical Machine that teaches a Pokémon the move Rock Tomb.

items.name: Star Piece
items.description: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red colour.

items.name: Revive
items.description: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon.

items.name: Tiny Mushroom
items.description: A small, rare mushroom. It can be sold for a low price.

items.name: Big Mushroom
items.description: A large, rare mushroom. It can be sold for a high price.

items.name: Dome Fossil
items.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a shell.

items.name: Helix Fossil
items.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a spiral shell.
